title: First paid job and spot jobs
summary: First job on banjo with a piano player at a private party; spot work with Kazimer and Clayton.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: The first job I played, I played with a piano player and uh, that was the first time I ever played on a job, the first time, just with a piano player. You remember that job?
With the banjo, yeah, with the banjo.
Do you remember what was that age?
Was it the private party or something else?
Who was the piano player, remember?
Uh, George White. No, you don't know him. Still around?
It's Leon Mumford's brother. Who? Remember Leon Mumford the piano? Yeah, yeah. His brother.
Oh yeah. Um, did you all have any regular jobs with the, say that Kazmer band we were talking about?
No, we didn't have any regular jobs, just spotting around, that's all. I spotting around with Clayton too.
About how, when was that? You were born in 1913, you see?
